ideas.title: Smash Piñatas for Pets 🪅
ideas.hook: A giant piñata hangs over your plot. Swing your bat to crack it open, and candy, coins and pet eggs rain down. Bigger piñatas drop rarer pets.
core_loop: Swing at the piñata over your plot
Grab the candy and eggs that spill out
Hatch eggs into pets that boost swing power
Buy stronger bats and unlock bigger piñatas (party, carnival, galaxy)
Rebirth for a permanent candy multiplier
ideas.twist: Every piñata has one golden hit spot that moves; landing a hit there doubles the drop, so timing beats button-mashing.
retention: Pet index with rare shiny variants
ideas.why_now: Hit / swing / launch is the fastest-rising mechanic at 2.74 momentum (34 new games), led by Throw Food For Animals (279,982 CCU) and Steal A Balut (49,177 CCU). Hatch + hit games are a live pair (4 new games, 54,345 CCU), and Food / candy is at 1.70 with +1 Power Fruit Evolution (8,580 CCU) and My Cookie Store 🍪[BETA] (6,455 CCU).
ideas.differentiator: Hit games pay out for distance; here every swing is also an egg roll, so the hit loop feeds a pet collection.

ideas.title: Toss Papers for Cash 🗞️
ideas.hook: Ride your bike down a busy street and fling newspapers at front doors. Hit the porch for cash, hit the mailbox for a bonus, hit a window and pay for it.
core_loop: Pick a delivery route
Ride and aim newspaper throws at doors and mailboxes
Earn cash per clean hit and a streak bonus
Buy faster bikes and heavier paper bundles
Unlock richer neighbourhoods that pay more per house
ideas.twist: Rich streets have guard dogs, sprinklers and rival riders who knock you off, so the best pay comes with the most chaos.
ideas.why_now: Hit / swing / launch is at 2.74 momentum and the hit + race/drive pair is the biggest hit combo (6 new games, 62,162 CCU), with Throw Food For Animals (279,982 CCU) and Bike For Egg! (21,259 CCU) showing the appetite. Money / rich is at 1.74 across 54 new games, and the "___ for ___" formula is at 1.54.
inspired_by: Can You Pass A Driving Test?
ideas.differentiator: Instead of standing still to launch, you throw while moving, so aim and steering are one skill.

ideas.title: +1 Moon Jump 🌕
ideas.hook: You're stuck on the Moon. Every jump gives you +1 jump height. Jump high enough to reach floating rocks, then the next planet's orbit.
core_loop: Jump to earn +1 jump height
Reach higher floating platforms and crystals
Spend crystals on gravity boots and trails
Leap to the next world (Moon, Mars, ring planet)
Rebirth for a permanent jump multiplier
ideas.twist: Meteor showers hit at random; staying airborne through one gives a big bonus, but getting hit drops you to the ground.
ideas.why_now: +1 stat per action is at 1.97 momentum across 39 new games, led by [⚔️UPD] +1 Venom Evolution (26,266 CCU) and +1 Spider Arm🕷️ (13,780 CCU). Space is at 1.79 and up 0.28 this week, with Sweep The Moon 🌕 (15,519 CCU), and the "+1 ___" formula is at 1.97.
ideas.differentiator: Low gravity makes every +1 visible as real height, and the meteor showers add a hazard most +1 games lack.

ideas.title: Draw Kites for Cash 🪁
ideas.hook: A storm is rolling in. Draw any kite shape you want, then launch it into the wind. The higher and longer it flies before the storm rips it apart, the more you earn.
core_loop: Draw a kite shape and pick a string
Launch it into the wind and steer through gusts
Earn cash for height and time aloft
Unlock stronger fabrics, longer strings and wilder weather
Show off your best kite in the gallery
ideas.twist: Each round the weather changes (breeze, gale, lightning, tornado), so a shape that wins in a breeze gets shredded in a gale.
ideas.why_now: Paint / create is at 1.79 momentum across 25 spread-out new games like [UPD1]⚽ Be a Soccer Legend (14,364 CCU) and Draw an aquarium (6,257 CCU). Paint × Disaster / weather is the second-biggest gap in the data (score 4.38), and Disaster / weather is at 1.73 with Hyper Realistic Ragdoll (17,530 CCU) and [🌊] Steal Eggs From Tsunami! (11,625 CCU).
ideas.differentiator: Most draw games just score the picture; here your drawing becomes a physics object that the weather tests.

ideas.title: Sell Rations to Soldiers 🪖
ideas.hook: Two toy armies are fighting across the field, and both are hungry. Run the supply tent in the middle, cook rations, and sell to whichever side pays more.
core_loop: Cook and pack rations at your stand
Sell to red or blue soldiers as they march past
Upgrade your tent into a supply depot
Hire helpers to pack and deliver faster
Unlock new fronts (desert, snow, beach)
ideas.twist: The side you sell to more gets stronger and pushes the front line, which moves your shop's best customers around the map.
ideas.why_now: Sell / run a shop is at 1.37 momentum across 35 new games, led by Sell Fries! [Anomaly] 🍟 (18,244 CCU) and 🧸 My Small Business (8,246 CCU). Military / war is at 1.14 and up 0.44 this week with Ragdoll Wars! (9,288 CCU) and Voxel Wars (8,114 CCU), and shop × military is an open gap (score 2.86).
ideas.differentiator: War games are about fighting; this one lets you profit from the war and steer it without firing a shot.

ideas.title: Dash Past the Tanks 🪖
ideas.hook: Cross a toy battlefield from one trench line to the other while tanks roll, shells land and planes strafe. Get hit and you ragdoll across the map.
core_loop: Sprint from cover to cover across the battlefield
Dodge shells, tank treads and strafing runs
Reach the next checkpoint flag to bank coins
Buy speed boots and shields
Unlock harder fronts with more firepower
ideas.twist: Explosions launch you as a ragdoll, and a lucky blast can fling you forward past whole sections, so risky routes can pay off.
ideas.why_now: Escape / run is at 1.37 momentum across 35 new games like [🏁] Steal A Pet And Ride It! (17,249 CCU) and 13 Days to Escape [ALPHA] (12,942 CCU). Physics Sim is at 2.15 and up 0.40 this week with Ragdoll Physics 🩸 (25,815 CCU), and escape × military is an open gap (score 2.86).
inspired_by: [🏁] Steal A Pet And Ride It!
ideas.differentiator: Escape games run from one hazard; here the whole map is the hazard and ragdoll physics turns hits into shortcuts.

ideas.title: Pick the Thief 🚨
ideas.hook: Something got stolen. Read the clues, look at the lineup, and point at the thief before the timer runs out. Right picks earn badges and cash.
core_loop: Get the case and three clues
Study the lineup of suspects
Pick the thief before time runs out
Earn badges and cash for right picks and fast answers
Rank up from rookie to chief
ideas.twist: One player each round is secretly the thief's lawyer and gets paid if the group picks wrong, so you have to argue it out.
ideas.why_now: Quiz is at 1.28 momentum with Rarest Answer Party! 🦐 (4,574 CCU) and Thai Quiz Duels [UPDATES] (3,085 CCU). Prison / police is at 1.33 across 16 spread-out new games led by 13 Days to Escape [ALPHA] (12,942 CCU), and quiz × prison is an open gap (score 2.32).
ideas.differentiator: Quiz games test trivia; this one tests reading people, and the secret lawyer adds a social twist.

ideas.title: Pull Giant Teeth 🦷
ideas.hook: Giants line up at your clinic with wobbly teeth. Tie a rope, yank, and launch the tooth across the town. Sell teeth to the Tooth Fairy shop for cash.
core_loop: Hook a rope to a giant's loose tooth
Time your yank to launch it as far as you can
Collect the tooth and sell it by size and shine
Buy stronger ropes, pliers and catapults
Unlock bigger giants with bigger teeth
ideas.twist: Some giants get grumpy if you miss and blow you out of the clinic with a sneeze, so the timing bar matters.
ideas.why_now: Hit / swing / launch is at 2.74 momentum with Throw Food For Animals (279,982 CCU) and Bloody Ragdoll Physics 🩸 (22,799 CCU). Giant / huge is at 1.68 and up 0.44 this week with Raise The Biggest Family (14,481 CCU) and Bug Evolution [🦟] (10,580 CCU).
ideas.differentiator: Instead of launching your own body, you launch something off a giant, and a shop turns the throws into a loop.

ideas.title: Build a Lighthouse 🌊
ideas.hook: Build a lighthouse on a stormy cliff. Ships that make it safely to harbour pay you. Every few minutes a big storm or a tsunami tests how well you built.
core_loop: Build up your lighthouse floor by floor
Light the beam to guide ships into harbour
Collect fees from every ship that docks
Repair and reinforce after each storm
Unlock tougher coasts with bigger ships and worse weather
ideas.twist: When the tsunami warning sounds you must run up your own tower before the wave hits, so a taller lighthouse is also your escape route.
monetization: Storm luck pass (better ships during storms)
retention: Rival keepers can steal unguarded cargo
ideas.why_now: Disaster / weather is at 1.73 momentum with Hyper Realistic Ragdoll (17,530 CCU), [🏁] Steal A Pet And Ride It! (17,249 CCU) and [🌊] Steal Eggs From Tsunami! (11,625 CCU). Tycoon / base building is at 1.22 across 86 new games, and "Build a ___" is at 1.20 and up 0.23 this week, led by Build a Bridge (11,539 CCU).
ideas.differentiator: Disaster games make you flee; here you build the thing that protects you and others pay you to use it.

ideas.title: Build a Space Station 🛰️
ideas.hook: Start with one tiny capsule in orbit. Add modules (labs, greenhouses, docks) to earn credits, and defend your station from rival raiders and space junk.
core_loop: Add modules to grow your station
Each module earns credits over time
Upgrade modules and connect them for combo bonuses
Fight off raiders who try to steal power cores
Unlock deeper orbits (Moon, Mars, asteroid belt)
ideas.twist: Your station slowly drifts; if you don't fire thrusters it can bump into a rival's station and both crews can board each other.
ideas.why_now: Space is at 1.79 momentum and up 0.28 this week with Sweep The Moon 🌕 (15,519 CCU) and Hyper Realistic Ragdoll (17,530 CCU). Robots / mechs is at 1.59 with [MARS] Clean the Moon! (3,627 CCU), fight + tycoon is a live pair (11 new games, 36,404 CCU), and "Build a ___" is at 1.20.
ideas.differentiator: Space games here are mostly clean-up sims; this gives space a base you grow and defend, with boarding fights.
